title: Notification generated on lifecycle state transition
gherkin:
Feature: Lifecycle Notification Generation
  Scenario: Generate notification when entity transitions to new lifecycle state
    Given an entity with current lifecycle state "active"
    When the entity transitions to lifecycle state "inactive"
    Then a notification should be generated
    And the notification should contain the new state "inactive"
    And the notification should contain the previous state "active"
rationale: Validates that the system generates notifications when lifecycle state changes occur, which is the core requirement of the lifecycle notification generation rule.
generationSummary: Lifecycle notification generation rule - Test suite covering the generation of notifications based on lifecycle state transitions and events. Tests validate that notifications are properly triggered, contain correct information, and follow the appropriate lifecycle rules.

title: Notification contains correct lifecycle state information

Feature: Lifecycle Notification Generation

    And the notification includes the entity identifier
